The '''Tauntaun Pup tent''' was a make of [[Tent/Legends|tent]] produced by the company [[Rim Excursions Inc.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The tent was made of from flexible, light-weight, [[alumasilk]] weave which contained an integrated heat-insulating layer, allowing any being inside the tent to ignore temperatures as low as minus twenty degrees. Sturdy and easy to store, the tent was popular with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] soldiers and [[Scout/Legends|explorers]], and cost 50 credits.<ref name="DC" /> The tent model shared its name with the [[Tauntaun/Legends|Tauntaun]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the ice-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tauntaun Pup tent was first mentioned in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
